#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""deepseek_tui_bot — Telegram bot backed by OpenRouter (DeepSeek)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import base64
import json
import logging
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import httpx
from telegram import Update, ChatAction
from telegram.ext import Application, CommandHandler, MessageHandler, filters, ContextTypes

# ── Config ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BOT_TOKEN = "8278051462:AAHDf3oZtWqWC-458DaQOJO5uhYrfT9jQYQ"
OPENROUTER_KEY = "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"
MODEL = "deepseek/deepseek-v3.2"
API_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions"
SYSTEM_PROMPT = "You are DeepSeek V3.2, a helpful AI assistant."

# ── Logging ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
logging.basicConfig(
    format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s",
    level=logging.INFO,
)
logger = logging.getLogger("deepseek_tui_bot")

# ── Session history ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
_sessions: dict[int, list[dict]] = {}

# ── API Call ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async def _call_api(chat_id: int, text: str, b64_uri: str | None = None) -> str:
    """Call OpenRouter chat completions, return full response text."""
    history = _sessions.setdefault(chat_id, [])
    history.append({"role": "user", "content": text})

    # Build payload with optional image
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT}]
    for msg in history:
        messages.append(msg)

    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENROUTER_KEY}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "HTTP-Referer": "https://t.me/deepseek_tui_bot",
        "X-Title": "deepseek_tui_bot",
    }
    payload = {
        "model": MODEL,
        "messages": messages,
        "stream": True,
    }

    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=120) as client:
        async with client.stream("POST", API_URL, json=payload, headers=headers) as resp:
            if resp.status_code != 200:
                body = await resp.aread()
                raise RuntimeError(f"API error {resp.status_code}: {body.decode()}")

            full = ""
            async for line in resp.aiter_lines():
                if not line.startswith("data: "):
                    continue
                data_str = line[6:].strip()
                if data_str == "[DONE]":
                    break
                try:
                    chunk = json.loads(data_str)
                    delta = chunk.get("choices", [{}])[0].get("delta", {})
                    content = delta.get("content", "")
                    if content:
                        full += content
                except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, IndexError):
                    continue

    history.append({"role": "assistant", "content": full})
    return full

# ── Download photo ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async def _download_photo(file_id: str) -> str | None:
    """Download Telegram photo, return base64 data URI."""
    try:
        url = f"https://api.telegram.org/file/bot{BOT_TOKEN}/{file_id}"
        async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
            resp = await client.get(url)
            if resp.status_code != 200:
                logger.warning("Failed to download photo: HTTP %s", resp.status_code)
                return None
            b64 = base64.b64encode(resp.content).decode()
            mime = resp.headers.get("content-type", "image/jpeg")
            return f"data:{mime};base64,{b64}"
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning("Failed to download photo: %s", e)
        return None

# ── Handlers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async def cmd_start(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE) -> None:
    """Handle /start command."""
    chat_id = update.effective_chat.id
    _sessions.setdefault(chat_id, [])
    await update.message.reply_text(
        "🤖 DeepSeek V3.2 Bot\n"
        "直接发消息对话\n"
        "/clear — 清空上下文\n"
        "/model — 查看当前模型\n"
        "支持文字和图片输入"
    )

async def cmd_clear(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE) -> None:
    """Handle /clear command."""
    chat_id = update.effective_chat.id
    _sessions.pop(chat_id, None)
    await update.message.reply_text("✅ 上下文已清空")

async def cmd_model(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE) -> None:
    """Handle /model command."""
    await update.message.reply_text(f"🧠 当前模型: `{MODEL}`", parse_mode="Markdown")

async def handle_message(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE) -> None:
    """Handle incoming text/photo messages."""
    chat_id = update.effective_chat.id
    user_text = update.message.text or update.message.caption or ""
    photo = update.message.photo

    await context.bot.send_chat_action(chat_id=chat_id, action=ChatAction.TYPING)

    # Handle photo
    b64_uri = None
    if photo:
        file_id = photo[-1].file_id
        file = await context.bot.get_file(file_id)
        b64_uri = await _download_photo(file.file_path)

    # Build user content
    user_content = user_text

    # Call API
    try:
        result = await _call_api(chat_id, user_content, b64_uri)
    except Exception as e:
        await update.message.reply_text(f"❌ API error: {e}")
        return

    # Send response (stream it by editing)
    msg = await update.message.reply_text("⏳ ...")
    sent = ""
    for i in range(0, len(result), 4000):
        chunk = result[i:i + 4000]
        sent += chunk
        try:
            await msg.edit_text(sent)
        except Exception:
            pass

# ── Main ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
async def main() -> None:
    """Start the bot."""
    logger.info("Starting deepseek_tui_bot (model=%s)...", MODEL)

    app = Application.builder().token(BOT_TOKEN).build()

    app.add_handler(CommandHandler("start", cmd_start))
    app.add_handler(CommandHandler("help", cmd_start))
    app.add_handler(CommandHandler("clear", cmd_clear))
    app.add_handler(CommandHandler("model", cmd_model))
    app.add_handler(MessageHandler(filters.TEXT | filters.PHOTO | filters.Caption, handle_message))

    logger.info("Bot started, polling...")
    await app.run_polling(drop_pending_updates=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
